The question asks which line represents the 'T' system. The caption provides information about the figure, stating that it shows the number of sentences selected from each system by the FromAll data selection approach for the EU-ES language pair in subsequent bins of 100,000 sentences. 

From the analysis of the figure, there are four lines representing different systems. The line labeled 'T' is represented by a solid black line. Therefore, the line representing the 'T' system is the solid black line.
